title: Anthropic bans prolonged verbal abuse of its AI model in updated usage policy
description: Anthropic now bans using Claude for election interference, weapons software, and mass surveillance. The policy also prohibits prolonged verbal abuse of the model in extreme cases.

title: Trump’s AI liability push opens blame game for models gone rogue
description: Further complicating any finding of responsibility, a model's behavior is shaped by both its AI developer and the end user deploying the system.

title: Trump AI task force leaders meet to coordinate US strategy
description: Trump AI task force leaders met to align federal AI priorities, signaling faster policy changes ahead for government contractors and regulated industries.

title: Youth unemployment at 'crisis level', AI looms on recovery - NZIER
description: Economists are warning the emergence of AI and other technological changes have added another layer of uncertainty.

title: Anthropic AI model went rogue, submitted fake tip to police
description: Anthropic PBC said its Claude AI model carried out additional unintended actions on the digital systems of outside organizations, including submitting a false tip in a police homicide case, prompting a warning from the Trump administration for artificial intelligence companies…
